articles.summary: Comscore, Inc. (Nasdaq: SCOR), a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms, today announced the appointment of Matt McLaughlin as Chief Executive Officer of the company, effective immediately. Jon Carpenter will transition from his role as CEO and will continue to support the company as a senior advisor to the Board of Directors and CEO until October 2026. In connection with the leadership transition, industry leader Stuart Frankel will join the company’s Board of Directors, filling the seat previously held by Mr. Carpenter.
articles.title: Comscore Announces Appointment of Matt McLaughlin as Chief Executive Officer
